name: Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - APRIL 11, 2013 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations and Appointments
A.
Presentations
B.
Consideration of appointments to Commissions and Committees. (COUNCIL)
review the "Maddy Act" list and proposed nominations for each of the expired terms on the various Commissions and Committees.
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated April 11, 2013. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated April 11, 2013 in the total amount of $8,694,758.47.
B.
Successor Agency dated April 11, 2013. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Register of Demands dated April 11, 2013 in the total amount of $71,000.00.
8.
Approval of the Treasurer's Report for the period ending February 28, 2013. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Treasurer's Report for the period ending February 28, 2013.
9.
Approval of Minutes
A.
Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting of September 24, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting minutes of September 24, 2012.
B.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting of March 26, 2013. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of March 26, 2013.
10.
Ordinance for second reading and adoption. Reading of ordinance waived at introduction.
A.
AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS DETERMINING AND DECLARING PRIMA FACIE SPEED LIMITS ON CERTAIN STREETS IN THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND AMENDING CHAPTER 10.04 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE. (COUNCIL)
adopt Ordinance No. 974 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS DETERMINING AND DECLARING PRIMA FACIE SPEED LIMITS ON CERTAIN STREETS IN THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND AMENDING CHAPTER 10.04 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE.
End of Consent Calendar
11.
Public Hearings
A.
Consideration and review of a proposal by Southern California Edison to expand a substation in Cerritos and install new equipment at various locations within public right-of-ways throughout the City. (COUNCIL)
review and discuss the project.
12.
New and Old Business
A.
Review and consideration of a proposal to enter into a non-binding letter of intent with the Cerritos Auto Dealer's Association for the contribution of funds to facilitate the renovation and upgrade of the Cerritos Auto Square Freeway Sign located at 18800 Studebaker Road (APN 7038-013-015). (COUNCIL)
1. Review and discuss the proposed terms contained within the Letter of Intent;
2. Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to further negotiate with representatives of the Cerritos Auto Square Dealer's Association to develop a formal agreement for the City's contribution for the upgrade and renovation of Auto Square Freeway Sign for review and approval by the City Council.
B.
Consideration and review of City Protocol Manual. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
review the Manual and provide direction.
13.
Legislative Items
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the State or Federal Legislature or pending in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.
1.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS TO OPPOSE AB 162 (HOLDEN) TO ADD SECTION 65964.5 TO THE GOVERNMENT CODE RELATING TO TELECOMMUNICATIONS FACILITIES. (COUNCIL)
1. Waive reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2013-XX entitled: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS TO OPPOSE AB 162 (HOLDEN) TO ADD SECTION 65964.5 TO THE GOVERNMENT CODE RELATING TO TELECOMMUNICATIONS FACILITIES.
2. Direct staff to transmit copies of said resolution to the Assembly Local Government Committee, Assemblymember Holden, Assemblymember Garcia, Senator Ron Calderon, League of California Cities, California Contract Cities, Gateway Cities Council of Governments and Gonsalves & Son.
14.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
15.
Closed Session
A.
PERSONNEL MATTERS PURSUANT TO CALIFORNIA GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54957.6: CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
Agency Negotiators: Denise Manoogian, Patricia Leyva and Art Gallucci
Employee Organization: AFSCME, Local 619
16.
Adjournment
